name: study-coach-sync
description: Socratic study coaching with GitHub-backed progress and summary synchronization.

interface.shortDescription: Keep Socratic study progress synchronized through GitHub.
interface.longDescription: Runs adaptive, bounded Socratic lessons in ChatGPT and Codex, then reads and updates a shared GitHub Markdown ledger for cross-product continuity.
defaultPrompt: Start or resume my study plan from the GitHub learning ledger.
Finish today's study unit and sync its summary to GitHub.
Show my current progress and due reviews.
